proposal.hypothesis: A factor-two target mapping with 256 threads (512 outputs per block) reuses each streamed source position and mass across two target accumulators while testing a larger CTA than the previously measured factor-two configurations. The larger CTA could affect scheduling or resource residency; prior factor-two candidates were valid but slower than baseline, so no speedup or occupancy effect is assumed. This path uses no shared-memory source staging.

retained: Map two target particles per thread, with the second target index offset by blockDim.x; retain independent force accumulators and self-interaction checks.
Load each streamed source particle's position and mass once per loop iteration and reuse them across valid targets; keep shared-memory allocation at zero.
Set the launch to 256 threads and 512 logical outputs per block, and bounds-check both targets so arbitrary N and partial final blocks are covered.
